text.p: Belgian polyvinyl chloride (PVC) profiles producer Deceuninck Plastics Industries NV said on Wednesday it expected its profit to rise further in 1997.

"Despite the investments and additional costs...which will be sparked by the recent acquisitions, a positive evolution of earnings is also expected for this year," Deceuninck said in its annual report.
It said 1997 had started "very well" in what was being considered a transitional year because of the integration of its U.S. acquisitions and its consolidation in Europe.
Deceuninck bought Dayton Technologies Inc, a Monroe, Ohio, based producer of extruded profiles for vinyl windows and patio door markets, after it had already acquired Slocomb Industries Inc in 1995.
Deceuninck said in March 1996 consolidated net profit rose 29.6 percent to 464 million francs.
